included.description:
Autonomous drone-operations platform, 56 microservices. Ship production LLM agents and retrieval systems alongside the distributed backend platforms that support them.

AI Engineering & Agentic Systems
• Built an end-to-end LLM-driven hiring pipeline — resume parsing, role-specific evaluation criteria, automated scoring, Slack routing, and GitHub-submission evaluation — reaching ~97% agreement with human reviewers.
• Built a RAG system over meeting transcripts, constrained to present only retrieved passages so answers stay grounded in the source.
• Built Task Whisperer, an agent that transcribes meetings, identifies action items and owners, and dispatches tasks to Slack with deadlines and status tracking.

Platform & Backend Engineering
• Designed a distributed usage-metering and billing-attribution pipeline (Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, ELK) with idempotent, reorder-safe event handling — recovering ~$30k/month of previously unattributed revenue.
• Moved analytics off the production DB via Airbyte into Postgres/Supabase, and converted the deployment into reproducible Kubernetes/Helm infrastructure with automated secrets.
• Built the Asset Management platform (map drawing, bulk import, live progress), responsive at 10k+ objects; moved it to HA Kubernetes (HPA, pod anti-affinity, rolling updates).
• Rebuilt the product's map into an interactive 3D scene streaming terrain/photogrammetry data, cutting sustained interaction CPU from 90–100% to 30–40%.
